Bicyclists of Iowa City Wednesday Night Ride

Iowa City, IA · Road

Bicyclists of Iowa City Wednesday Night Ride is a road group ride in Iowa City, IA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Varies (Quinton's, Flannigan's, North Liberty, Solon); see the BIC calendar. About 18–28 miles, 13–18+ mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 13–18+ mph. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bicyclists of Iowa City Wednesday Night Ride group ride

A weeknight loop ride of 18 to 28 miles with fewer stops than the club's social rides. Start point rotates among a few bars and nearby towns. BIC also runs Monday relaxed-pace rides for new riders, Tuesday morning rides and Saturday rides of 20 to 100 miles.
